analytics.name: Analytic 1708
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Accounts by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: AccountManager.getAccounts() OR getAccountsByType() called > $AccountEnumThreshold$ times within $AccountEnumWindow$ by app NOT IN $ApprovedAuthenticatorApps$]; Network Traffic Flow via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]; Permissions Request via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: MDM agent, approved authenticator, sync adapter apps. Minimal.
Default 5 calls — sync adapters call getAccountsByType once per type; bulk = enumeration.
Default 5KB — account metadata is small; even small upload is significant.

log_sources.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: AccountManager.getAccounts() OR getAccountsByType() called > $AccountEnumThreshold$ times within $AccountEnumWindow$ by app NOT IN $ApprovedAuthenticatorApps$

analytics.name: Analytic 1709
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect Accounts by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: SecItemCopyMatching() called with kSecMatchLimitAll]; Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
